description: Ex-US Army 69-15489. Delivered June 1970, served with the United Nations Emergency Force II at Ismailia, Egypt 1976-79 and with 171 Squadron, 1st Aviation Regiment; took part in the final Army Iroquois flight over Brisbane 21/09/2007. Moved to the Port Pirie RSL for indoor display in April 2014 (ADF-Serials).
